title: Didacta Module Package Layout (v1)
description: Declarative contract for the layout of a Didacta module ZIP. Consumed by the backend validator and any packager. Spec version embeds in major version of @didacta/module-package-spec.

maxPackageBytes.description: 50 MB. Hard cap to prevent zip bombs and disk abuse. Mirrors apps/api MAX_PACKAGE_BYTES.

requiredFiles.description: Files whose absence triggers PACKAGE_MISSING_FILE. Case-sensitive POSIX paths.

forbidPathTraversal.description: Reject any entry whose path contains '..' or starts with '/'. Anti-zip-slip.

forbidBackslash.description: ZIP entries must use forward slashes. A backslash indicates a malformed ZIP from a Windows-only writer.

forbidAbsolute.description: Reject entries starting with '/' or with drive letters (C:, D:).

allowSubdirs.description: Migrations must be flat. Prisma's native subdir layout (<ts>_<name>/migration.sql) MUST be flattened by the packager (see normalizer.normalizeMigrations).

allowedExtensions.description: Only .sql files are accepted. migration_lock.toml, README.md, hidden files etc. must be stripped by the packager.

filenamePattern.description: Conservative whitelist for filenames. Excludes paths, traversal, control chars.

errorCodes.description: Error codes this layout schema can produce. Mirror of MarketplaceErrorCode in the backend.
